C1.worst_defect: The hero is heavy on text. A five-line centred lead paragraph, two buttons and a note line all sit above the till screenshot, so the product image starts low on the first screen. Below it, 'What it does today' is ten identical grey cards with no icons or visual anchor, and the section reads as a uniform block.

C2.worst_defect: Only small faults. The 'Live demo or your own store' table puts the long refund caveat in a single cell, so one row is much taller than the rest. Otherwise the claims are specific and the limits are stated plainly.

C3.worst_defect: Quick start has no screenshot of what success looks like: neither the till sign-in screen nor a synced order in the Vendure Dashboard. 'Check it worked' is a text-only checklist, so a first-time reader cannot compare their screen with the expected one.
C3.where: quick-start.desktop.03-04, step 8 'Sign in and make a sale'

C4.worst_defect: Most docs pages are unbroken walls of text with no figure or diagram. Overview 'How a sale reaches Vendure' explains an offline-queue-then-sync flow in prose alone. Limitations bullets carry about 48 px of gap between items, much looser than the tight lists on the other pages, so the page rhythm is inconsistent.

C5.worst_defect: The three screenshots on At the till are framed three different ways. The payment screen runs full width with no inner padding. The cashier sheet is about 420 px wide and centred in a padded frame, which reads as a frame inside a frame. The closure screen is about 545 px wide in another padded frame. Separately, the first row of home cards is uneven, leaving dead space at the bottom of 'Every sale lands once'.

C6.worst_defect: At 390 px: the cashier-sheet image shows a grey vertical scrim strip on its left edge. The inline code 'packages/vendure-plugin/CHANGELOG.md' wraps into two chips, 'packages/vendure-' and 'plugin/CHANGELOG.md'. Inline code chips push the line height up in step 4 of Quick start and in Troubleshooting. 'X-report' breaks after the hyphen. On home, the phone till screenshot cuts the category chips off at 'Gif', and the ten cards stack into about 2.5 screens of identical boxes.

C7.worst_defect: On /docs/quick-start, Lighthouse performance is 79, with 790 ms of total blocking time and 2.6 s of main-thread work. In the share card, the subtitle leaves 'a normal order.' as a short orphan line, and the bottom edge crops the screenshot through 'Add charge'. Metadata, llms.txt, the sitemap, robots, JSON-LD and the 404 are all clean.

overall_worst.defect: The figures on At the till have no single treatment. One runs full width with no padding (the payment screen), one is about 420 px and centred inside a padded frame (the cashier sheet), and one is about 545 px in another padded frame (closure). On phone the cashier sheet also shows a grey scrim strip on its left edge. The docs look assembled rather than designed.
overall_worst.fix: Define one figure component for every docs screenshot. Crop each image tight to the UI so it carries no baked-in padding or scrim. Give every figure the same frame (1 px border, the same radius, no inner padding) and the same width rule: full content width for wide screens, and a single fixed max-width (e.g. 480 px), centred, for phone-shaped sheets. Add a short caption under each.
